items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Mopsy Russel and Aretha Franklin. Aretha came on. and she's my favorite singer.

ctx.x: Oh, Sickle-cell Anemia? That's right, yes, yes.

Mopsy Russel and Aretha Franklin. Aretha came on. and she's my favorite singer. Her sister, she came on first and she does more about a different kind of trouble than Aretha does. Aretha sings more the sacred part with her music and this was like the profane part, the blues, you know. Oh she's good. I've got to get her album. But I like, those are my favorite singers like Stevie Wonder. Now I'm a pop music man really basically. I was raised on pop music
and my favorite singers have always been pop singers. Because I was raised with it. We never had any concert or classical music. We never had that kind of home...
